title: Olivia Dean, Kehlani, Juanes & More to Announce 2027 Grammy Nominations
summary: And heads-up: The 2027 Grammys will air/stream at 4 p.m. PT, one hour earlier than before.
contentText:
Olivia Dean is widely expected to receive multiple Grammy nominations, including album, record and song of the year, on Monday Nov. 16. She’s also set to help announce the nominations on a livestream bright and early that morning, along with Kehlani , who won two Grammys earlier this year and could be in line for more awards for her eponymous album; Amy Allen , who has won songwriter of the year, non-classical the last two years; and Pharrell Williams , a past three-time winner of producer of the year, non-classical.

Other artists set for the nominations livestream include Alan Menken, Carly Pearce, David Guetta, FYÜTCH & Aura V, Herbie Hancock, Israel Houghton, Juanes, Linda Perry, Meghan Foley & Michelle Holme, Renée Fleming, YUNGBLUD and Ziggy Marley, as well as Harvey Mason jr., Grammys CEO, and Dr. Chelsey Green, chair of the Recording Academy Board of Trustees.

Nominees across all 100 categories for the 2027 Grammys will be revealed during a special presentation on Grammy.com and the Grammys YouTube channel, with special live coverage on Good Morning America . The nominations livestream begins on Monday, Nov. 16 at 7:45 a.m. ET / 4:45 a.m. PT. There will be a wrap-up show at 9 a.m. ET/6 a.m. PT (times approximate).

For the first time, the Grammy Nominations special presentation will be broadcast live at The Square in Times Square, presented by Hilton.

The complete nominations list will be published on Grammy.com and at Billboard.com at 9:00 a.m. ET / 6:00 a.m. PT.

The Grammys also made an important announcement about the 2027 Grammys, which will air one hour earlier than in the past. The 69th annual Grammy Awards will air/stream live on Sunday Feb. 7, 2027 at 7:00 p.m. ET / 4:00 p.m. PT on ABC, and stream on Disney+ and Hulu.

This follows the lead of the Oscars, which first moved up their show to start at 4 p.m. PT for the 96th Academy Awards in 2024. The move is designed to allow viewers on the East Coast to remain with the show for the top awards without having to stay up to midnight. 2024 was Raj Kapoor’s first year as an executive producer of the Oscars. Kapoor is also an executive producer of the Grammys.

The 2027 Grammys will again be held at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles.
